title: PRCreatorReport
description: PR Creator report: status, pr_url, and a short summary. Place these fields directly as the tool input — no outer wrapper.

status.description: created: you pushed the feature branch and opened a new pull request this turn. existing: you discovered an open pull request already exists for the feature branch and reused its URL without pushing or creating anything.

pr_url.description: Full GitHub pull request URL of the form 'https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/pull/{number}'.

summary.description: One short sentence describing what you did (e.g. 'Opened PR for agent/wf-123 with approved spec rev 2.' or 'Reused existing PR #42 for agent/wf-123.').
